verses: Qaaf! boht bari shaan walay uss Quran ki qasam hai
Balkay)yeh unhen tajjub maloom hua kay unn kay pass unhi mein say aik aagah kerney wala aaya to kafiron ney kaha kay yeh aik ajeeb cheez hai
Kiya jab hum marr ker mitti ho jayen gay. Phir yeh wapsi door (az aqal) hai
Zamin jo kuch unn say ghatati hai woh humen maloom hai aur humaray pass sab yaad rakhney wali kitab hai
Balkay)yeh unhon ney sachi baat ko jhoot kaha hai jabkay woh unn kay pass phonch chuki pus woh aik uljhao mein parr gaye hain
Kiya unhon ney aasman ko apney upper nahi dekha? Kay hum ney ussay kiss tarah banaya hai aur zeenat di hai uss mein koi shigaf nahi
Aur zamin ko hum ney bicha diya aur uss mein hum ney pahar daal diye hain aur uss mein hum ney qasam qasam ki khushnuma cheezen uga di hain
Takay her rujoo kerney walay banday kay liye beenaee aur danaee ka zariye ho
Aur hum ney aasman say ba-barkat pani barsaya aur uss say baghaat aur katney walay khet kay ghallay peda kiye
Aur khujooron kay buland bala darakht jin kay khoshay teh ba teh hain
Bandon ki rozi kay liye aur hum ney pani say murdah shehar ko zindah ker diya. Ussi tarah (qabron say) nikalna hai
Unn say pehlay Nooh ki qom ney aur rass walon ney aur samood ney
Aur aad ney Firaun ney aur biradran-e-loot Loot ney
Aur Aikah walon ney tubba’a ki qom ney bhi takzeeb ki thi. Sab ney payghumbaron ko jhutlaya pus mera wada azab unn per sadiq aagaya
Kiya hum pehli baar kay peda kerney say thak gaye? Balkay)yeh yeh log naee pedaeesh ki taraf say shak mein hain
Hum ney insan ko peda kiya hai aur uss kay dil mein jo khayalaat uthtay hain unn say hum waqif hain aur hum uss ki sheyrag jaan say bhi ziyadah uss say qareeb hain
Jiss waqt do lenay walay jaa letay hain aik dayen taraf aur aik bayen taraf betha hua hai
(insan) mun say koi lafz nikal nahi pata magar kay uss kay pass nigehbaan tayyar hai
Aur maut ki bey beyhoshi haq ley ker aa phonchi, yehi hai jiss say to bidakta phirta tha
Aur soor phoonk diya jaye ga. Wada azab ka din yehi hai
Aur her shakhs uss tarah aaye ga kay uss kay sath aik laney wala hoga aur aik gawahi denay wala
Yaqeenan to uss say ghaflat mein tha lekin hum ney teray samney say pardah hata diya pus aaj teri nigah boht tez hai
Uss ka hum nasheen (farishta) kahey ga yeh hazir hai jo kay meray pass tha
Daal do jahannum mein her kafir sirkash ko
Jo nek kaam say rokney wala hadd say guzar janey wala aur shak kerney wala tha
Jiss ney Allah kay sath doosra mabood bana liya tha pus ussay sakht azab mein daal do
Uss ka humnasheen (shetan) kahey ga aey humaray rab! mein ney ussay gumrah nahi kiya tha balkay)yeh yeh khud hi door daraz ki gumrahi mein tha
Haq Taalaa farmaye ga bus meray samney jhagarney ki baat mat kero mein to pehlay hi tumhari taraf waeed (wada azab) bhej chuka tha
Meray haan baat badalti nahi aur na mein apney bandon per zara bhi zulm kerney wala hun
Jiss din hum dozakh say poochen gay kiya to bhar chuki? Woh jawab dey gi kiya kuch aur ziyadah bhi hai?
Aur jannat perhezgaron kay liye bilkul qareeb ker di jaye gi zara bhi door na hogi
Yeh hai jiss ka tum say wada kiya jata tha her uss shakhs kay liye jo rujoo kerney wala aur pabandi kerney wala ho
Jo rehman ka ghaeebana khof rakhta ho aur tawajja wala dil laya ho
Tum uss jannat mein salamti kay sath dakhil ho jao. Yeh hamesha rehney ka din hai
Yeh o haan jo chahayen unhen milay ga (balkay)yeh) humaray pass aur bhi ziyadah hai
Aur unn say pehlay bhi hum boht si ummaton ko halak ker chukay hain jo unn say taqat mein boht ziyadah thin woh shehron mein dhondtay hi reh gaye, kay koi bhagney ka thikana hai?
Uss mein her sahib-e-eman dil kay liye ibrat hai aur uss kay liye jo dil say mutawajha ho ker kaan lagaye aur woh hazir ho
Yaqeenan hum ney aasmano aur zamin aur jo kuch uss kay darmiyan hai sab ko (sirf) chhe din mein peda ker diya aur humen thakaan ney chua tak nahi
Pus yeh jo kuch kehtay hain aap uss per sabar keren aur apney rab ki tasbeeh tareef kay sath biyan keren sooraj nikalney say pehlay bhi aur sooraj ghuroob honey say pehlay bhi
Aur raat kay waqt bhi tasbeeh keren aur namaz kay baad bhi
Aur sunn rakhen kay jiss din aik pukarney wala qareeb hi ki jagah say pukaray ga
Jiss roz uss tund o tez cheekh ko yaqeen kay sath sunn len gay, yeh din hoga nikalney ka
Hum hi jilatay hain aur hum hi maartay hain aur humari hi taraf lot phir ker aana hai
Jiss din zamin phat jaye gi aur yeh dortay huye (nikal paren gay) yeh jama ker lena hum per boht hi aasan hai
Yeh jo kuch keh rahey hain hum bakhoobi jantay hain aur aap unn per jabar kerney walay nahi, to aap Quran kay zariye unhen samjhatay rahen jo meray waeed (daraney kay wadon) say dartay hain
